title: PowerPoint: clearer on-screen presenting controls for single-screen Slide Show
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's planned single-screen Slide Show changes and November 2026 target without claiming a launch. Independent searches confirmed the stated documentation gaps; the product-level licensing and general Cloud Policy statements are supported by the cited Microsoft pages.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Apps includes PowerPoint.
claims.quote: It includes familiar apps like Access, Excel, OneDrive, OneNote, Outlook, PowerPoint, Publisher, Skype for Business, Teams, and Word.

claims.claim: The web versions of Office applications, including PowerPoint, are included with all Office 365 and Microsoft 365 plans.
claims.quote: The web versions let users open and work with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or OneNote documents in a web browser. The web versions of these Office applications are included with all Office 365 (and Microsoft 365) plans.

claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Apps is a version of Office that's available through Office 365 plans. To use Microsoft 365 Apps, a user must have a Microsoft 365 account and assigned a license.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy service is a general means of enforcing policy settings for Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise.
